target.title: fix: enforce W&B sandbox ownership
target.body:
## Summary

- require W&B existing-sandbox run, status, and stop operations to prove membership in provider inventory tagged `crabbox`
- fail closed before Exec, Get, or Stop when tagged inventory is unavailable or does not contain the requested ID
- document the ownership boundary and why `--reclaim` remains unsupported

Closes https://github.com/openclaw/crabbox/issues/786

## Verification

Current candidate: `ed1db34bc7132bd174035e25d14f54a9441ca2bc`

Local validation on the current candidate:

- `git diff --check origin/main...HEAD`
- `go test -race ./internal/providers/wandb`
- `go vet ./internal/providers/wandb`
- `go vet ./...`
- `scripts/check-docs.sh`

Hosted validation on the current candidate:

- Go: pass
- Worker: pass
- Apple VZ: pass
- Scripts: pass
- Docs: pass
- Release Check: pass
- CodeQL analyses: pass

## Pre-merge live gate

Blocked pending W&B/CoreWeave credentials: this shell has no `WANDB_API_KEY`, `CRABBOX_WANDB_API_KEY`, `COREWEAVE_API_KEY`, or `CRABBOX_COREWEAVE_API_KEY`. This PR must remain unmerged until authenticated exact-head proof shows: tagged owned sandbox existing-ID run/status/stop succeeds, a Crabbox-labelled but unowned sandbox is denied, and cleanup leaves zero residue.

## Security / configuration

No new credential or configuration requirement. Raw W&B sandbox IDs are now accepted for mutable or command-execution operations only when the provider-side `crabbox` ownership tag is present.
